name: Create an OVHcloud k2 server
description: Create a k2 backup server in this OVHcloud project.

id.label: Cloud project
id.description: Cloud project in which the k2 server will be created.

name.label: Server name
name.description: Name assigned to the new k2 server.
name.help: Use a name that clearly identifies the backup server.

region_id.label: Region
region_id.description: Cloud region in which the k2 server will be created.
region_id.help: Select a region available in the synchronized provider catalog.

deployment_zone_id.label: Deployment zone
deployment_zone_id.description: Deployment target in which the k2 server will be created.
deployment_zone_id.help: Select a deployment zone available in the chosen region.

flavor.label: Server flavor
flavor.description: Compute and memory configuration of the k2 server.
flavor.help: Select a flavor available in the chosen region.

image.label: Operating system image
image.description: Operating system image installed on the k2 server.
image.help: Select an image available in the chosen region.

billing_period.label: Billing period
billing_period.description: Billing frequency applied to the k2 server.
billing_period.help: Select hourly billing for flexibility or monthly billing for a monthly commitment.
